hooks.text: 赛前选择斗士、站位和行为指令，战斗自动演算并检验克制判断
hooks.excerpt: Choose gladiators for each fight, position them, and instruct their behavior. The battle will play out on its own, showing you the results of your strategy. Keep a close watch on your enemy, understand their moves, and figure out how to best counter them.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 斗士特质决定额外能力，可从市场淘人或训练升级特质并搭配装备
hooks.excerpt: Gladiators have traits that determine their bonuses and additional abilities. You can find great deals in the market or teach and upgrade traits as you form the strategy for your team. Unleash your creativity by growing your unique team. Level them up, upgrade traits, and equip them with powerful items, all while planning carefully how to build the most efficient team of gladiators that work well together.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 每轮选择不同主要阵营，改变主线任务、结局和队伍策略
hooks.excerpt: Replayability Each time you play, you can choose a different main allegiance, resulting in different main quests and endings while you try different team strategies.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
